title: "Fig. 4C - Shrb RNAi Cas/LamC phenotype penetrance"
output: null
date: "2026-01-15"
---


```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggprism)
source("analysis_helpers.R")
```

```{r}
# Fig. 4C: calculate phenotype penetrance percentages for Cas and LamC markers.

data_file <- "../Data/Fig4C_shrbRNAi_Cas_LamC_phenotype_penetrance.csv"
output_file <- "../Results/Fig4C_shrbRNAi_Cas_LamC_phenotype_penetrance.pdf"

shrb_rnai_cas_lamc_phenotype_penetrance <- read_analysis_csv(data_file) %>%
  mutate(Phenotype_Penetrance_Percent = 100 * `Phenotype Penetrance` / Total_Germaria)
```

```{r}
# Fig. 4C: compare phenotype penetrance between control and shrb RNAi for each
# marker. Fisher's exact test uses the underlying scored counts and handles the
# complete LamC separation in these data.

stat_results <- shrb_rnai_cas_lamc_phenotype_penetrance %>%
  group_by(`Cell Marker`) %>%
  summarise(
    Control_Positive = sum(`Phenotype Penetrance`[Group == "Control"], na.rm = TRUE),
    Control_Negative = sum(`No Phenotype`[Group == "Control"], na.rm = TRUE),
    Shrb_Positive = sum(`Phenotype Penetrance`[Group == "shrbRNAi"], na.rm = TRUE),
    Shrb_Negative = sum(`No Phenotype`[Group == "shrbRNAi"], na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    p = fisher.test(
      matrix(
        c(Control_Positive, Control_Negative, Shrb_Positive, Shrb_Negative),
        nrow = 2,
        byrow = TRUE
      )
    )$p.value
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    p.signif = case_when(
      p <= 0.0001 ~ "****",
      p <= 0.001 ~ "***",
      p <= 0.01 ~ "**",
      p <= 0.05 ~ "*",
      TRUE ~ "ns"
    ),
    xmin = if_else(`Cell Marker` == "Cas", 0.8125, 1.1875),
    xmax = if_else(`Cell Marker` == "Cas", 1.8125, 2.1875),
    y.position = if_else(`Cell Marker` == "Cas", 104, 112),
    group1 = "Control",
    group2 = "shrbRNAi"
  )

stat_results
```

```{r}
# Fig. 4C: plot Cas and LamC phenotype penetrance by genotype.

shrb_rnai_cas_lamc_phenotype_penetrance %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Group, y = Phenotype_Penetrance_Percent, fill = `Cell Marker`)) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = scales::percent_format(scale = 1),
    limits = c(0, 115),
    breaks = c(0, 25, 50, 75, 100)
  ) +
  geom_boxplot(aes(color = `Cell Marker`), fill = "white", linewidth = 0.35, outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_jitter(
    position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.2, dodge.width = 0.75),
    alpha = 0.8,
    size = 1.2
  ) +
  ggpubr::stat_pvalue_manual(
    stat_results,
    label = "p.signif",
    xmin = "xmin",
    xmax = "xmax",
    y.position = "y.position",
    bracket.size = 0.3,
    tip.length = 0.03,
    size = 2.5,
    family = "Arial",
    hide.ns = TRUE,
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  manuscript_theme() +
  theme(
    legend.position = c(0.8, 0.35),
    legend.justification = c(1, 1),
    legend.background = element_rect(fill = scales::alpha("white", 0.85), color = NA),
    legend.key.size = unit(0.25, "cm"),
    legend.spacing.y = unit(0.01, "cm"),
    legend.margin = margin(1, 2, 1, 2)
  ) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, title = "% with extra Cas+ or LamC+ cells\n")
```

```{r}
ggsave(output_file, width = 2, height = 2.5, units = "in", device = cairo_pdf)
```

```{r}
# Fig. 4C: manuscript summary values for phenotype penetrance.

summarize_mean_sd(
  shrb_rnai_cas_lamc_phenotype_penetrance,
  group_cols = c("Group", "Cell Marker"),
  value_col = Phenotype_Penetrance_Percent
)
```
